title: GAB Biohazard Canister
description: A rusted, leaking biohazard canister lies on its side in a surreal desert landscape. The canister features a large red prohibition symbol over a grotesque screaming face with wide eyes, while the word 'GAB' is painted in dripping white letters on its body.
prompt: A heavily rusted and dented metal biohazard canister lying on its side in a barren desert, covered in dripping paint and hazard symbols. A large red prohibition circle with a crossed-out screaming grotesque face with bulging eyes is painted on its surface. The word GAB is prominently painted in white dripping letters. In the background are geometric crystalline mountains under a blood-red sun with dripping liquid, purple and orange sky, scattered mechanical parts, handprints and abstract symbols in the sand, surreal nightmare aesthetic, detailed painting style.
